mapper.select: SELECT rv.id AS id, rv.recipe_id AS recipeId, r.dish_name AS dishName, r.description AS description, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ri.image_url ORDER BY ri.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM recipe_images ri WHERE ri.recipe_id = rv.recipe_id ) AS images FROM recipe_views rv LEFT JOIN recipes r ON r.id = rv.recipe_id WHERE rv.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rv.created_at DESC
